text: 男的40岁自动变成大佬吗？
en: Do men automatically become big shots at 40?

text: 说得好像女人没要求一样，女人只是年轻不是傻，小姑娘的父母又不是死了
en: As if women have no requirements, like women are merely young and not stupid; the parents of those young girls aren't dead either.

text: 我四十多岁的光棍三叔连寡妇都找不到
en: My unmarried third uncle in his forties can't even find a widow.

text: 有的时候是真的很想报警，这帮老登就喜欢对同龄女性指指点点，意淫有很多年轻女孩生扑他们，作为年轻女孩只想说：我们造了什么孽不能找同龄人。
en: Sometimes I really want to call the police; these old geezers just love to point fingers at women their own age and fantasise that many young girls throw themselves at them. As a young girl, all I want to say is: what crime did we commit that we can't go for people our own age?

text: 因为有些人的概念里，女人会贬值。
en: Because in some people's minds, women depreciate.

text: 而男人不一样，越老越值钱，自带升值属性。
en: Men are different; the older they are, the more valuable they become, with an inherent appreciation quality.

text: 他们最常说的一句话：女人四十豆腐渣，男人四十一枝花。
en: The line they say most often: a woman at forty is like bean curd dregs, a man at forty is a flower in full bloom.

text: 没钱，失业，贬值，变丑…
en: No money, unemployment, depreciation, growing ugly…

text: 那都是女人的事。
en: Those are all a woman's affairs.

text: 男人没这个顾虑，男人越老越值钱，总有十八的小姑娘可选。
en: Men have no such worry; the older a man is, the more valuable he becomes, and there are always eighteen-year-old girls to choose from.

text: 属于认不清现实。
en: It comes down to a failure to recognise reality.

text: 有钱人，不分男女，可选的大把。
en: Rich people, regardless of gender, have plenty to choose from.

text: 没钱人，也不分男女，是不会有十八的看上你的。
en: Poor people, regardless of gender too, will not have an eighteen-year-old take a liking to you.

text: 俺一个同事，四十多岁了，男的。
en: A colleague of mine, in his forties, a man.

text: 他说女的再漂亮，在我眼里和男的一样，当时觉得他装正经，
en: He said no matter how beautiful a woman is, in his eyes she's the same as a man; at the time I thought he was just putting on an act of propriety,

text: 这话我现在有点信了，我觉得我十几岁到二十多够色了…
en: I now half believe what he said; I think from my teens to my twenties I was randy enough…

text: 看到美女都心动。
en: and my heart would flutter at the sight of a beautiful woman.

text: 但是现在29岁的年龄了，感觉已经到发现不了女人好看在哪里了。
en: But now at 29, I feel I've reached the point where I can no longer tell what's beautiful about women.

text: 不就是和男人一样，都是人吗，虽然还是有点冲动，但是确实已经和十年前没法比了。
en: Aren't they just the same as men, both being human? Though there's still a bit of impulse, it really can't compare with ten years ago.

text: 心里已经慢慢的淡了。
en: My heart has slowly grown indifferent.

text: 我闺蜜的表姐，今年44岁，是旁人一眼看去就格外惊艳的精致女人。
en: My best friend's cousin, 44 this year, is a refined woman who strikes others as especially stunning at first glance.

text: 多年岁月几乎没在她身上留下痕迹，身材匀称挺拔毫无发福走样，皮肤白皙细腻，一头乌黑长发常年绾成温婉发髻，身姿优雅、气质贤淑。
en: The years have left almost no trace on her; her figure is well-proportioned and upright with no sign of gaining weight or losing shape, her skin fair and delicate, and her jet-black long hair worn year-round in a gentle, graceful bun; her bearing is elegant and her temperament gentle and virtuous.

text: 单看背影体态，说是三十出头都有人信，举手投足的韵味，让不少同龄人暗自心动。
en: Judging solely by her silhouette and posture, people would believe she's just over thirty; the charm in her every gesture makes many of her peers secretly captivated.

text: 表姐离婚多年，独自把女儿拉扯长大。
en: The cousin divorced years ago and raised her daughter single-handedly.

text: 自从去年女儿升入高中住校，家里彻底清净下来，她便动了心思，想找个踏实靠谱的伴侣，开启自己的第二段人生。
en: Since last year, when her daughter entered senior school and began boarding, the house fell completely quiet, and she took it into her mind to find a steady, dependable partner and begin her second chapter of life.

text: 身边亲友全都笃定，以表姐的样貌、气质和通透的性子，再找个伴根本不是难事。
en: All her relatives and friends were certain that, with the cousin's looks, temperament and clear-headed nature, finding another companion would be no difficulty at all.

text: 可谁也没想到，真正踏入相亲市场后，她才真切体会到：中年女人想找个三观契合、人品靠谱的像样男人，简直比登天还难！
en: Yet no one expected that once she truly stepped into the matchmaking market, she would realise firsthand: for a middle-aged woman to find a decent man with compatible values and reliable character is harder than climbing to heaven!

text: 几段相亲经历，是表姐亲口讲述的，听完让人又无奈又唏嘘。
en: Several of these matchmaking experiences were told by the cousin herself, and listening to them leaves one feeling both helpless and wistful.

text: 第一位：35岁浮华装修老板，空有皮囊全是假象
en: The first: a 35-year-old flashy renovation boss, all appearance and nothing but illusion.

text: 这是表姐接触的第一个相亲对象，35岁，做装修工程生意。
en: This was the cousin's first matchmaking partner, 35, in the renovation business.

text: 男人外在条件看着十分亮眼，衣着精致讲究，谈吐看似得体，开着奔驰，住着两百多平的大平层，孩子归前妻抚养，看着事业有成、生活体面。
en: The man's external conditions looked most impressive: finely dressed and fastidious, seemingly poised in speech, driving a Mercedes, living in a flat of over two hundred square metres, with his child raised by his ex-wife; he appeared successful in his career and living a respectable life.

text: 起初表姐对他印象尚可，只觉得对方年纪偏小，怕是心态不成熟，大概率有恋母情结，或是只想消遣暧昧。
en: At first the cousin's impression of him was fair; she only felt he was on the young side, feared his mindset was immature, likely had an Oedipus complex, or simply wanted casual flirtation.

text: 相处没多久，真相就彻底暴露了。
en: It didn't take long together before the truth was fully exposed.

text: 一次逛街，表姐看中商场一套高端护肤品，随口提了一句，男人瞬间支支吾吾，反复推脱，只说等工程款结了就给她买，次次画饼从不兑现。
en: Once while shopping, the cousin took a liking to a high-end skincare set in a mall and mentioned it casually; the man hesitated and stammered, repeatedly putting her off, saying only that he'd buy it for her once the project payment came through, feeding her empty promises each time that he never fulfilled.

text: 后来表姐偶然去他公司楼下，在电梯偶遇一位中年房东。
en: Later, the cousin happened to go downstairs at his company and met a middle-aged landlord in the lift.

text: 躲在一旁听清对话才知道，他早已拖欠房租，正低声下气求人宽限几日，承诺工程款到账就补齐半年租金。
en: Hiding to one side and overhearing the conversation, she learned he had long been behind on rent and was humbly begging for a few days' grace, promising to make up the half-year's rent once the project funds arrived.

text: 表姐托朋友查了底，更是大吃一惊：他常开的奔驰是二手车，全程处于抵押状态，还有足足20个月的贷款没还清。
en: The cousin asked a friend to look into his background and was even more shocked: the Mercedes he drove regularly was a second-hand car, fully under mortgage, with a full twenty months of loan still unpaid.

text: 光鲜外表下全是负债和虚浮，这场初识，表姐当即果断止损，彻底断了联系。
en: Beneath the glossy exterior lay nothing but debt and hollowness; at this first acquaintance the cousin promptly cut her losses and broke off contact completely.

text: 第二位：39岁大厂离职程序员，看透世事彻底躺平
en: The second: a 39-year-old former programmer from a big tech firm, having seen through the world and completely lying flat.

text: 这位是所有相亲对象里，唯一真心想和表姐安稳共度余生的人。
en: He was, among all the matchmaking partners, the only one who genuinely wanted to spend the rest of his life peacefully with the cousin.

text: 男人39岁，本地人，此前一直在杭州头部互联网大厂做程序员，巅峰时月薪三万，风光无限。
en: The man, 39, a local, had previously worked as a programmer at a top internet company in Hangzhou; at his peak his monthly salary was thirty thousand, and he enjoyed unlimited glory.

text: 他前半生活得压抑憋屈，入赘女方家庭多年，前妻是独生女，婚房由女方购置，岳父岳母就住在对门。
en: His first half of life was lived repressed and aggrieved; he had married into the wife's family for years, his ex-wife being an only child, the marital home purchased by the wife's side, with his father- and mother-in-law living right across the hall.

text: 他常年996拼命打拼，所有收入几乎都用来补贴家用、偿还房贷，在家里毫无话语权，受尽冷眼和委屈。
en: Year after year he toiled under a 996 schedule, pouring all his earnings almost entirely into the household and mortgage repayments, with no say at all in the family, enduring cold looks and grievances.

text: 去年遭遇大厂裁员，失业三个月无果，再也找不到高薪工作。
en: Last year he was caught in the big-tech layoffs; after three months unemployed with no result, he could no longer find a high-paying job.

text: 房贷压力、家人的冷眼嘲讽，彻底压垮了他。
en: The mortgage pressure and his family's cold ridicule completely broke him.

text: 积攒多年的怨气一朝爆发，他砸毁家里物品，决然离婚，开启了一年的全国旅居生活。
en: The resentment built up over years erupted at once; he smashed items in the home, resolutely divorced, and began a year of travelling and living around the country.

text: 他花光遣散费、卖掉爱车，走遍大理、伊犁、漠河等地，彻底放空自己。
en: He spent all his severance pay and sold his beloved car, travelling through places like Dali, Yili and Mohe, completely emptying himself.

text: 回归家乡后，他彻底看淡高薪体面的工作，选择做一名快递员，日子简单纯粹。
en: After returning home, he completely let go of high-paying, respectable work and chose to become a delivery courier, living a simple and pure life.

text: 每天分拣派件、和各行各业的普通人打交道，闲暇逛菜市场、做饭散步、喝茶追剧，不争不抢、无欲无求。
en: Every day he sorts and delivers parcels and deals with ordinary people from all walks of life; in his spare time he wanders the wet market, cooks, takes walks, drinks tea and binges shows, striving for nothing and craving nothing.

text: 他早已规划好晚年生活，打算迁回农村户口，守着自家小院和几亩田地，归隐田园、安度余生。
en: He had long planned his later years: he intends to move his household registration back to the countryside, keeping his own small courtyard and a few mu of fields, retreating to the countryside to live out his remaining years in peace.

text: 表姐格外欣赏他历经千帆的通透和坦然，可两人终究不是一路人。
en: The cousin especially admired his clarity and composure after weathering a thousand sails, yet the two were ultimately not the same kind of people.

text: 她是世俗里的普通人，往后还要帮女儿带娃、退休后享受烟火生活、安享天伦之乐，没办法放下一切，陪他归隐乡村种地度日。
en: She is an ordinary person of the world; going forward she must still help her daughter raise the child, and after retirement enjoy a worldly life and the joy of family togetherness. She couldn't put everything down and accompany him to retreat to the village and farm for a living.

text: 再三斟酌后，表姐坦然选择了放手。
en: After much deliberation, the cousin calmly chose to let go.

text: 第三位：40岁浪漫语文教师，精致利己的伪才子
en: The third: a 40-year-old romantic Chinese-language teacher, a refined yet self-serving fake man of letters.

text: 这位男士是重点初中语文老师，40岁，温文儒雅、文采斐然，写得一手漂亮的瘦金体书法。
en: This gentleman is a Chinese-language teacher at a key junior secondary school, 40, gentle and refined, with brilliant literary talent, and he writes a beautiful hand of Slender Gold script calligraphy.

text: 初识时，他极致浪漫，用牛皮纸信封、粉色信笺写下满满深情情书，字句滚烫，打动了沉寂多年的表姐。
en: When they first met, he was exceedingly romantic, writing love letters brimming with deep feeling on kraft envelopes and pink notepaper, his words burning hot, moving the cousin who had been dormant for years.

text: 日常相处里，他亲手做精致小礼物，带着表姐吃遍全城美食，温柔体贴，氛围感拉满。
en: In daily life together, he made exquisite little gifts by hand and took the cousin to every fine eatery in the city; gentle and considerate, he maxed out the ambience.

text: 两人踏踏实实交往了近三年，可最大的阻碍，是他正值叛逆期的儿子。
en: The two dated steadily for nearly three years, yet the biggest obstacle was his son, who was in his rebellious phase.

text: 孩子打心底抵触表姐，坚决不接受她进门，甚至放话，若是父亲执意再婚娶她，自己就转学投奔生母、改随母姓。
en: The child resisted the cousin from the bottom of his heart and firmly refused to accept her into the home; he even declared that if his father insisted on remarrying her, he would transfer schools to live with his birth mother and take her surname.

text: 表姐一直耐心包容，觉得孩子年少叛逆，假以时日总能化解隔阂，可三年过去，孩子的抵触丝毫未减。
en: The cousin remained patient and tolerant, feeling the child was simply being rebellious in his youth and that given time the estrangement could always be resolved; yet three years on, the child's resistance had not diminished in the slightest.

text: 压垮这段感情的最后一根稻草，是男方母亲突发脑梗住院。
en: The last straw that broke this relationship was the man's mother suddenly suffering a cerebral infarction and being hospitalised.

text: 男人忙于朋友聚会，脱不开身，再三恳求表姐帮忙去医院陪护一晚。
en: The man was busy with a friends' gathering and couldn't get away, repeatedly begging the cousin to help by staying a night at the hospital to look after his mother.

text: 念及多年情分，表姐心软答应，连夜赶到医院照料。
en: Thinking of their years of affection, the cousin softened and agreed, rushing to the hospital overnight to care for her.

text: 可谁料，老太太和孙子想法一模一样，打心底认定表姐图谋家产，对着她百般挑剔、恶语相向，整整谩骂了一个小时。
en: Yet who could have expected that the old lady shared exactly the same thinking as her grandson, convinced at heart that the cousin was after the family fortune, subjecting her to all manner of fault-finding and vicious words, berating her for a full hour.

text: 从未受过这般委屈的表姐，当即收拾东西转身离开。
en: The cousin, who had never suffered such grievance, packed her things on the spot and turned to leave.

text: 她打电话告知男人，让他自行回来照料母亲。
en: She called the man to tell him to come back himself and care for his mother.

text: 让人寒心的是，男人酒意正酣，不仅不心疼表姐受的委屈，反而一味指责她不懂包容、没有爱心，还以此为由，果断提出分手，笃定她日后不会孝顺长辈。
en: What was chilling was that the man, deep in his cups, not only felt no sympathy for the cousin's grievance but instead blamed her for lacking tolerance and compassion, and on that basis decisively proposed breaking up, certain she would never filially respect her elders in future.

text: 看清对方精致利己的真面目后，表姐彻底爆发，当场怒斥对方虚伪的本性，潇洒斩断三年情分，再不回头。
en: Having seen through his refined yet self-serving true colours, the cousin completely erupted, on the spot angrily denouncing his hypocritical nature, and coolly cut off the three-year bond, never looking back.

text: 第四位：45岁国企工程师，抠门多疑还沾恶习
en: The fourth: a 45-year-old state-owned-enterprise engineer, stingy and suspicious with a bad habit to boot.

text: 男人45岁，国企资深工程师，工作稳定、无房贷压力，有一个儿子归前妻抚养。
en: The man, 45, a senior engineer at a state-owned enterprise, with stable work and no mortgage pressure, has a son raised by his ex-wife.

text: 外形条件尚可，身材挺拔不发福、看着精神干练，对表姐十分中意，主动示好追求。
en: His appearance was acceptable, his figure upright without gaining weight, looking spirited and capable; he took a strong liking to the cousin and actively courted her.

text: 唯一让表姐介意的，就是他性格过于吝啬。
en: The only thing the cousin minded was his overly miserly character.

text: 两人第二次见面，当天寒风凛冽、大风呼啸，他为了省钱，竟直接约表姐逛露天公园。
en: On their second meeting, the day was bitterly cold with howling wind; to save money, he actually suggested the cousin stroll with him through an open-air park.

text: 满目枯枝败叶、寒风刺骨，表姐实在难耐，主动提议去旁边瑞幸坐坐。
en: With withered branches and fallen leaves everywhere and a bone-piercing wind, the cousin truly couldn't bear it and suggested they sit a while at the nearby Luckin.

text: 临近买单时，男人刻意假装接电话避单，最后全程沉默，是表姐主动买了咖啡。
en: As they neared paying the bill, the man deliberately pretended to take a call to avoid the treat, and in the end stayed silent throughout; it was the cousin who volunteered to buy the coffee.

text: 本以为只是节俭，后续相处更让人颠覆认知。
en: One might have thought it mere thrift, but further time together was even more mind-bending.

text: 一次两人吃小龙虾约会，男人开始动手动脚，一边越界亲近，一边画饼承诺，说要购置新房、登记两人共同名字。
en: Once, on a date eating crayfish, the man began to get handsy, drawing close inappropriately while feeding her empty promises, saying he would buy a new home and register both their names on it.

text: 交谈间隙，他的手机不断响起，大多是信用卡分期推销、网贷催收电话。
en: In the gaps in conversation his phone kept ringing, mostly with credit-card instalment sales calls and online-loan collection calls.

text: 男人月薪过万，生活朴素、无大额开销、无房贷负债，唯一的可能，就是沾染了赌博恶习。
en: The man earned over ten thousand a month, lived plainly, with no large expenses and no mortgage debt; the only possibility was that he had picked up the bad habit of gambling.

text: 表姐心里瞬间警觉，还没等她核实，男人就主动微信开口，向她借3000元应急，承诺三日归还。
en: The cousin's guard went up instantly; before she could even verify, the man took the initiative on WeChat to ask to borrow 3000 yuan for an emergency, promising to return it in three days.

text: 表姐没有理会，紧接着对方电话打来，听筒里清晰传来噼里啪啦的麻将声。
en: The cousin ignored him, and then his call came through, with the crisp sound of clattering mahjong clearly audible from the receiver.

text: 表姐瞬间心寒至极，她当初离婚，就是因为前夫嗜赌成性、败光家产。
en: The cousin's heart turned utterly cold in an instant; her divorce in the first place was precisely because her ex-husband was addicted to gambling and squandered the family fortune.

text: 一朝被蛇咬十年怕井绳，她当即挂断电话，拉黑所有联系方式，彻底远离。
en: Once bitten by a snake, one fears a rope for ten years; she hung up at once, blocked all means of contact, and stayed completely away.

text: 第五位：47岁体制内正科级干部，执念传宗接代
en: The fifth: a 47-year-old in-system regular section-level cadre, fixated on carrying on the family line.

text: 最后一位是亲友介绍的优质人选，47岁，体制内正科级干部，丧偶独居，条件十分优越，坐拥两套房产，女儿读高二、成绩优异。
en: The last was a quality candidate introduced by relatives and friends: 47, an in-system regular section-level cadre, widowed and living alone, with excellent conditions, owning two properties, his daughter in her second year of senior school with outstanding grades.

text: 男人性格直爽通透，直言自己仕途已定、升迁无望，只想找个温柔踏实的人共度余生，女儿也全力支持他再婚。
en: The man had a frank and clear-headed character; he stated plainly that his official career was set and promotion hopeless, and he only wanted to find a gentle, steady person to spend his remaining years with, and his daughter fully supported his remarriage.

text: 可谈及未来规划时，他提出了一个硬性要求：希望婚后再生一个儿子。
en: Yet when it came to future plans, he raised a hard requirement: he hoped to have another son after marriage.

text: 他坦言，两人各自只有女儿，家里条件优渥，完全有能力抚养孩子，想圆自己儿女双全、传承香火的心愿。
en: He confessed that each of them had only a daughter, the family conditions were comfortable, and they were fully able to raise a child; he wanted to fulfil his wish of having both a son and a daughter and carrying on the family line.

text: 男人目测表姐年轻精致，误以为她不过38岁，生育毫无压力。
en: The man estimated the cousin looked young and refined and mistakenly thought she was no more than 38, with no pressure at all to bear children.

text: 但表姐每年定期体检，清楚自己44岁高龄，再次生育风险极高、伤身伤身。
en: But the cousin has a regular annual check-up and knows she is already 44, a high age, and bearing another child carries extremely high risk and harms the body.

text: 除此之外，表姐也想得格外长远：两人中年得子，等孩子成年，二人早已年迈退休，精力体力根本无力抚养；往后还要帮各自儿女带孙辈，家庭琐事、生活压力变数太大，晚年生活必将疲惫不堪。
en: Beyond that, the cousin also thought especially long-term: the two having a child in middle age means that by the time the child comes of age, the couple will already be elderly and retired, with energy and stamina quite insufficient to raise them; going forward they would also have to help their respective children with grandchildren, and with household trivia and life pressures so variable, their later years would surely be exhausting.

text: 她坦诚说出所有顾虑，男人表面表示理解，说回去仔细斟酌，可自此之后，再也没有主动联系过她。
en: She candidly voiced all her concerns; the man expressed understanding on the surface and said he would ponder it carefully at home, yet from then on he never took the initiative to contact her again.

text: 没过多久，表姐便听闻，这位正科级干部，直接拿出28万彩礼，火速迎娶了一位30岁的二婚女性。
en: Not long after, the cousin heard that this regular section-level cadre directly produced a 280,000-yuan bride price and hastily married a 30-year-old divorced woman.

text: 婚后家里矛盾不断，他的女儿极度反感乡下出身的后妈，连带着对刚出生的弟弟也满心排斥，家里争吵不断、风波不止。
en: After the marriage the family was in constant conflict; his daughter intensely resented the stepmother of rural origin and, by extension, was full of rejection towards the newly born little brother, and the home was endlessly full of quarrels and turmoil.

text: 单位同事日日议论，都想不通精明半生的老干部，为何执着传宗接代，非要拼生儿子，仿佛普通公职需要世袭传承一般。
en: Colleagues at his unit gossiped daily, all unable to understand why this shrewd old cadre, halfway through life, was so fixated on carrying on the family line and insisted on striving to bear a son, as if an ordinary public post needed to be passed down by inheritance.

text: 后续亲友还陆续给表姐介绍过几位相亲对象，要么年纪偏大、要么社保不全，要么只想找个人搭伙过日子、免费做家务，表姐索性连见面都直接婉拒。
en: Later, relatives and friends successively introduced a few more matchmaking candidates to the cousin; either too old, or without full social insurance, or merely wanting someone to muddle through life with and do housework for free; the cousin simply declined even meeting them outright.

text: 历经这几段糟心的相亲经历，44岁的表姐早已看淡释怀。
en: Having been through these distressing matchmaking experiences, the 44-year-old cousin had long since let go and made her peace.

text: 如今的她，不再执着于二婚成家，日子清净自在。
en: Now she no longer clings to remarrying and starting a family, living a quiet and free life.

text: 圈子里的无效社交越来越少，不用迁就任何人、不用妥协将就。
en: There is less and less pointless socialising in her circle; she needn't accommodate anyone or compromise and make do.

text: 她闲暇养花遛弯、护肤养生、经营自己的小生活，慢慢发现，与其将就一段内耗的婚姻，不如好好独爱自己，一个人的安稳自在，胜过凑合的岁岁年年。
en: In her leisure she grows flowers and takes strolls, cares for her skin and health, and tends her own little life; she slowly discovers that rather than settling for a marriage of internal drain, it is better to lovingly care for herself alone — the steadiness and freedom of one person surpass the years of making do.
